name: Crises, Catastrophies and Exceptional Situations in Law
description: Concepts, organization and structure as well as actors of internal security in the field of disasters, crises, civil protection and civil defense in Germany ; studies of past as well as fictitious crises and disasters (floods, pandemics, terrorist attacks, war, blackouts) ; potentials and risks of governmental access and intervention for hazard prevention; basics of the law of hazard prevention.
prerequisites: The students should  have prior knowledge of the basic principles of the german legal system (i.e. regularly fullfilled with the successful completion of the course "Einführung in das Recht der digitalen Gesellschaft")
